description: The graph illustrates the loss evolution over iterations for various models, including StrmLLM and multiple configurations of SepLLM, as part of a study on accelerating large language models through compression. The x-axis represents the number of iterations, ranging from 0 to 140,000, with major tick marks at intervals of 20,000, and is labeled as "#Iteration". The y-axis represents the loss value, scaled linearly from 2.4 to 3.4, with major tick marks at intervals of 0.1. The legend identifies five distinct lines: StrmLLM (n=64) in purple, SepLLM (n=64) in orange, SepLLM (n=64, H) in green, SepLLM (n=64, H/T) in red, and SepLLM (n=128) in blue. All lines begin at a loss value of approximately 3.35 at iteration 0 and exhibit a sharp initial decrease, with the loss dropping below 2.8 by around 20,000 iterations. After this initial phase, the loss curves for all models converge and stabilize, showing a slow, steady decline. By iteration 140,000, the loss values for all models are very close, ranging from approximately 2.51 to 2.54. The SepLLM (n=128) model, represented by the blue line, consistently maintains the lowest loss across the entire range of iterations, while the StrmLLM (n=64) model, represented by the purple line, shows the highest loss after the initial drop.
